reports.headline: The Hillside Was Hollowed Out
reports.body: Something has blasted a tunnel straight into the hillside {dir} of the village {dist}, its walls fused smooth. {name} followed it a little way and heard a voice deep inside asking the same thing over and over: are you satisfied?

reports.headline: A Voice in the Blasted Tunnel
reports.body: Those who go into the new tunnel {dir} of here {dist} come out shaking. {name} says it was not the dark that frightened {them}. It was the voice asking, and how badly {they} wanted to answer no.
